OnlineVerificationInfo.heading: Get ready for selfie and ID check
OnlineVerificationInfo.followSteps: Follow the steps to complete the process
OnlineVerificationInfo.step1: You will need one government issued photo ID
OnlineVerificationInfo.expiredIdsAccepted: Expired IDs are accepted if they expired less than 6 months ago
OnlineVerificationInfo.step2: Take a selfie and a photo of your ID in a well lit room using a mobile phone camera with a high resolution
OnlineVerificationInfo.step3: Confirm your submission and get your proofing results to continue
OnlineVerificationInfo.planForTime: Plan for about 5 minutes to complete this process.
OnlineVerificationInfo.learnMoreLink: Learn more about how selfie and ID check works

InPersonProofingInProgress.changedMindText: Changed your mind about in-person proofing at Canada Post? You can reset and choose a different method instead.

StartIdentityProofing.pageTitle: {{rpName}} needs you to prove your identity
StartIdentityProofing.heading: Identity proofing confirms who you are, protects against fraud, and lets you recover your {{appName}} if needed.
StartIdentityProofing.howToProveHeading: How do you want to prove your identity?
StartIdentityProofing.onlineInstantOption: Prove identity online and get instant access
StartIdentityProofing.onlineInstantHint: Do either a selfie and ID check or sign with a provincial account (BC, AB).
StartIdentityProofing.inPersonSignBackInOption: Do it in person and sign back in when done
StartIdentityProofing.inPersonSignBackInHint: Set up a visit to a Canada Post or Service Canada Centre with valid government-issued ID.
StartIdentityProofing.cantProveNowOption: Need more time, or a different way in

StartIdentityProofing.documentScanningOption: Selfie and photo of your ID

StartIdentityProofing.bodyText: You will only need to do this once for all services that require identity proofing.
StartIdentityProofing.errorNoticeTitle: Your identity could not be verified
